title: Fresh Bar Salts Fizzy Cherry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid By Pukka Juice
description: Fizzy Cherry from Fresh Bar is a deliciously tempting fruit candy flavour that will light up your tastebuds with its tantalising taste. Ruby-red Cherry candy adds its sugary sweetness to a layer of effervescent Sherbet, creating a flavour that’s as delicious as it is nostalgic. If you love the kind of intense, satisfying flavours found in the most popular disposable vape bars, then you’re bound to find them in Fresh Bars mouth-watering collection of Nic Salt 10ml e-liquids. They’re a more sustainable option over single-use disposable vapes, and can be used in a wide variety of vape kits. This premium Fresh Bar e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG ratio offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production, and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices with high-resistance coils. Unlike regular freebase e-liquids, nicotine salts’ unique alkaline formulation allows for a higher concentration of nicotine while delivering a smoother throat hit than traditional high-strength, high-PG freebase liquids are capable of. Also, with nicotine salt e-liquids, the nicotine is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing near-instant relief from nicotine cravings! Fresh Bar are a brand of e-liquids from vape masters Pukka Juice, an award-winning UK e-liquid company behind some of the most popular e-liquids today. From nic salts, to 50/50 e-liquids, Fresh Bar e-liquids draw inspiration from the most popular disposable vape bar flavours.
